changeSet.sql: update hr_monthly_data hr set hr.hr_variable = REPLACE(hr_variable, 'ADVANCE', 'LOAN' ) WHERE hr.hr_variable like '%ADVANCE%'; update hr_monthly_data hr set hr.source_type = REPLACE(hr_variable, 'SALARY_ADVANCE', 'SALARY_LOAN' ) WHERE hr.source_type like '%SALARY_ADVANCE%';
